meta.title: Loyalty program: interactive demo
meta.description: Demo of a points club for a fictitious drugstore chain with sample Colombian data: enroll customers with data-processing consent, record checkout purchases with multipliers, redeem rewards, set up tiers, missions and campaigns within allowed hours, and see the points liability. Everything is calculated in your browser.

demoLoyalty.pageSubtitle: Enroll customers at checkout, award points with rules by category, day and channel, redeem the store's own rewards and measure what the program costs. Everything works on this page with sample data.
demoLoyalty.sampleHint: {brand} (NIT {nit}), {club}, its stores, members, ID numbers, phone numbers, partners and all figures are made up.

howItWorks.title: What is real in this demo
howItWorks.real: Calculated for real in your browser: the points for each purchase (base rule plus multipliers by category, day and channel), the balance as the sum of the points ledger, tiers, redemptions with coupons and checkout discounts, missions, referrals, fraud rules, allowed campaign hours, the cost simulator, the points liability and the CSV export. Your changes are saved only in this browser.
howItWorks.simulated: Simulated: sending WhatsApp, email or SMS (you see the preview, no message is sent), the Apple Wallet and Google Wallet pass (preview), sweepstakes, and the figures for the 29,200-member base (KPIs, cohorts, mission results, A/B tests and partners). The WhatsApp and email buttons in “Invite friends” do open your app with the message ready.
howItWorks.project: In your project, the checkout connects to your POS or online store through an API, points live in a points ledger in your database, messages go out through WhatsApp Business with approved templates, the pass is issued for Apple Wallet and Google Wallet with your brand, and reports come from your real data.

steps.1: Checkout: search 300 555 0142 (Laura) and record $185,000 in Personal care on Tuesday: she earns 370 points thanks to double points on Tuesdays. You can also enroll someone new with their consent.
steps.2: Record another purchase, for example $420,000 in Dermocosmetics: Laura moves up to Gold and completes the “Buy 2 times this month” mission.
steps.3: Member app: check the balance and activity, claim the mission and redeem “Free delivery” (600 points): the balance drops and you get a coupon.
steps.4: Settings › Points: change the day rule to ×3 and see in the simulator how many points the same purchase earns and what the program costs.
steps.5: Results: review the points liability and what you did in the demo, export the activity as CSV and create a campaign from a segment within the hours allowed by Law 2300.
